q: The graph entropy h_{Σ,G}(μ,T) for a sofic approximation Σ = (σᵢ: G → Sym(dᵢ)) and a partition P (finite measurable) is defined as:
opts: The topological entropy of the shift
(1/dᵢ) log |Hom_μ(P, σᵢ, ε)| in the limit as i → ∞ and ε → 0
The KS entropy of the partition
The Hausdorff dimension of the orbit closure
exp: Bowen's sofic entropy: hΣ(μ,T,P) = lim_{ε→0} limsup_{i→∞} (1/dᵢ) log |good models|, where good models are maps from dᵢ into the partition P that approximately reproduce the distributions of words under T. This limits to the KS entropy for amenable G.
